instructions: Determine whether the evidence supports all materially important parts of the claim. Judge only from the supplied evidence.

criteria.supported: The evidence explicitly states or directly entails every materially important part of the claim.
criteria.not_supported: The evidence fails to support at least one materially important part of the claim. This includes missing information, partial support, contradiction, incorrect numbers/dates/entities, scope overreach, or unsupported causal/detail additions.
